name: body-not-json
description: A 200 whose body is an HTML error page rather than JSON -- what a reverse proxy or a captive login in front of the SWIS port actually answers. Decoding it would abort the whole run; the guard must print, report zero, and stop. request_count 1 pins that the failure is not retried.  The task now ENDS IN ERROR. A primary response the script cannot read means no inventory, which is not an empty one.

log_contains: swis: failed to retrieve assets: the response body was not JSON
error_contains: the response body was not JSON
